text:
Marta: Hey finance team, AcmeCorp flagged a month-end mismatch — invoice total is $12,400 but dashboard shows $9,800. Can someone triage?
Simon: Ugh, that’s a big gap. Any idea which line(s) are different?
Marta: Customer says extra line called "burst_reserved" for 2026-02-28, 02:00 UTC. Dashboard doesn't show it. Attached screenshot from customer.
Keisha: Pulling the invoice rows now. One sec.
billing-bot: Invoice 987654321 rows: plan_base 9800, burst_reserved 2400, credits -0. Total 12200. (system note: generated by invoicer v2.1.4)
Sam: That system total is $12,200, Marta said $12,400 — could be tax rounding. But still ~2.4k surprise.
Keisha: Querying metering for AcmeCorp on 2026-02-28 00:00-06:00 UTC. SQL: ```SELECT usage_category, sum(tokens) FROM meter_events WHERE account_id='acme' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-02-28' AND '2026-03-01' GROUP BY 1;```
Keisha: Result looks normal — no burst_reserved category in meter_events. Dashboard pull shows plan_base tokens ~980k, billed as expected.
Simon: Could be post-hoc billing job that adds reserved burst lines from backfill. Any recent backfills?
Marta: Customer mentioned they upgraded plan mid-window — maybe migration path created a phantom reserved burst.
Sam: Checking backfill logs: `/var/logs/billing/backfill-2026-03-01.log` snippet: "WARN account=acme action=apply_reserved_burst reason=legacy_migration tokens=240000"
Keisha: That log line would explain $2,400 if pricing is 0.01 per 100 tokens. Who triggered the backfill?
Simon: Looks like a scheduled job `legacy-migration-reconcile` ran at 02:05 and patched accounts that had old quota records. It updated billing rows but didn't emit metric events, so dashboard never saw it.
Marta: So invoice includes post-run adjustments but dashboard relies on meter_events only. Customer is upset because they didn't get notice.
Sam: Short term: offer credit for the burst_reserved line while we verify. Long term: fix backfill to emit synthetic meter events and add an audit email.
Keisha: Repro steps for eng: 1) run reconcile on a test acct with legacy_quota; 2) confirm invoice rows created in invoice DB (`invoices.lines`); 3) check `meter_events` insertion. I can drop a small repro script.
Keisha: Script snippet: ```python
# apply reconcile
apply_legacy_reconcile(account='acme-test')
# check invoice rows
SELECT * FROM invoices.lines WHERE account='acme-test' AND description LIKE '%reserved%';
# check meter_events
SELECT * FROM meter_events WHERE account='acme-test' AND source='reconcile';
```
Simon: Assigning to eng-billing for a patch. @sam can you open a support ticket draft for the customer offering a one-time credit and noting we will follow up with a mitigation plan?
Sam: On it. Drafting now, will include proposed credit $2,400 and ETA for root-cause fix 48 hours.
Marta: Thanks. Please mark internal severity P2. Also tag product for notification requirements. :exclamation:
billing-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03-01-42 assigned to eng-billing.
Keisha: I'll also add a short-term dashboard flag so CS sees accounts with invoice-only adjustments. Patch boarding to next deploy window.
Simon: Good. After patch, let's run reconciliation for Feb accounts and generate a small report for finance to review.
Marta: Confirmed. I'll reply to AcmeCorp with the credit offer and ask for a screenshot if they have one (they already provided). Will update this thread after ticket and credit complete. :thumbsup:
